audit.why: A poke-mage mirror: Brand's instant W-on-E burst wins short trades pre-4 against Lux's aimable Q, then it flattens into a pure skillshot duel once both sides threaten a one-shot off a landed root/stun.

Neither appears anywhere; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are instead verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad.

audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d to state the W-shield bait and dontsFull[2].d to state the grouping/Illumination risk.

edits.before: W-poke the pair — the pillar splashes bot's formation tax from level 1.
edits.after: At level 1 your instant W beats Lux's dodgeable Q poke.

edits.before: E joins: the ablaze-stun package threatens; the lane flinches at level 2.
edits.after: Your level-2 W-on-E burst out-trades her slower snare setup.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stuns through the wave and the W bills the dodge attempt.
edits.after: At level 3 your combo damage still pressures her in short trades.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Force Prismatic Barrier (W) out before you commit — it absorbs the burst that decides the trade.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Grouping lets one Q snare double-charge Illumination on two targets — spread so E-R only tags one.

edits.before: Commit on Light Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Light Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. It writes your spacing rules. - E-Q stun package is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
